title: Apostille Convention & Document Attestation in Bangladesh: MOFA Legalization Guide for USA, UK & Canada (2026)
metaTitle: Apostille Bangladesh: Document Legalization & MOFA Guide 2026
metaDescription: Exhaustive legal guide on Bangladesh's accession to the Hague Apostille Convention. How to apostille & legalize birth, marriage, police & educational certificates.
heroIntro: For decades, Non-Resident Bangladeshis (NRBs), international students, skilled immigrants, and foreign corporate investors faced an exhausting, bureaucratic ordeal known as the 'chain legalization' of documents. Authenticating a Bangladeshi birth certificate, marriage certificate (Nikahnama), Police Clearance Certificate (PCC), university transcript, or commercial Power of Attorney required a multi-tier marathon: notarization by a local notary, attestation by the relevant administrative ministry, authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) in Dhaka, and final costly legalization by foreign embassies (US, UK, Canadian, German, Australian missions). This landscape underwent a monumental transformation with **Bangladesh's formal accession to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention (Apostille Treaty)**. Under the Apostille system, a single standardized **Apostille Certificate** issued by the designated Competent Authority in Bangladesh (MOFA) eliminates all subsequent foreign consular legalization across over 125 member countries. This master legal guide provides the complete procedural manual to navigating the Apostille regime, digital e-Apostille verification, transitional protocols for non-member states, and document certification standards.

quickAnswer.heading: Bangladesh Apostille System: 7 Core Rules
points: Hague Apostille Convention: Eliminates the requirement of diplomatic or consular legalization for public documents among contracting member states.
Designated Competent Authority: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), Consular & Welfare Wing, Segunbagicha, Dhaka is the sole designated national authority.

Applicable Documents: Police Clearance Certificates (PCC), 17-digit online Birth & Death Certificates, registered Marriage Certificates (Nikahnama / Special Marriage), Educational Diplomas, and Court Decrees.

Prerequisite verification: Documents must be verified by the originating administrative authority (Education Board/UGC for degrees, Law Ministry for Kazi deeds, Police HQ for PCC) prior to MOFA apostille.
Digital e-Apostille: MOFA issues digital certificates featuring unique QR codes and electronic verification registers for instantaneous foreign border validation.
Non-Apostille Nations: For countries not party to the Hague Convention (e.g. UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait), traditional bilateral embassy legalization remains mandatory.
Overseas Applicants: NRBs living in the US, UK, or Canada can have their domestic documents apostilled in Dhaka through an authorized legal counsel without returning to Bangladesh.

sections.h2: 1. What is the Hague Apostille Convention & Bangladesh's Accession
sections.content:
The Convention of 5 October 1961 Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents, commonly known as the Hague Apostille Convention, is an international treaty administered by the Hague Conference on Private International Law (HCCH). Its core objective is to replace the cumbersome, expensive, and protracted chain-certification process with a single standardized legal certificate called an Apostille (French for 'certification').

Under Article 1 of the Convention, the treaty applies to public documents executed in the territory of one contracting state which have to be produced in the territory of another contracting state. Bangladesh's accession to the treaty represents a major economic and diplomatic milestone, directly benefiting millions of expatriates in North America, Europe, East Asia, and Australasia by slashing document certification timelines from months to days and eliminating thousands of dollars in consular fees.

sections.h2: 2. Traditional Chain Legalization vs The Single Apostille Certificate
sections.content:
To understand the revolutionary impact of the Apostille, consider the contrast between the old and new certification mechanisms:

A. The Traditional 'Chain Legalization' Ordeal (Pre-Apostille)

Under the traditional regime (which still applies to non-member nations), a document had to pass through an agonizing bureaucratic gauntlet: (1) Local Notary Public stamp, (2) Verification by originating Ministry (Ministry of Education, Ministry of Law, or Home Affairs), (3) Authentication by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Dhaka, (4) In-person submission and fee payment at the foreign destination country's embassy in Dhaka (e.g. German, Italian, or Spanish Embassy), and (5) Ministry of Foreign Affairs verification in the destination country.

B. The Modern Apostille System

Once a public document receives the official Apostille Stamp from MOFA Bangladesh, it is automatically recognized by law in all member states (including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Japan, and all 27 European Union member states) without requiring any further signature, stamp, or verification from foreign embassies in Dhaka.

sections.h2: 4. Which Bangladeshi Documents Are Eligible for Apostille?
sections.content:
Under Article 1(2) of the Convention, the following categories of Bangladeshi public documents are eligible for an Apostille:

  1. Civil Status & Vital Records: 17-digit online Birth Registration Certificates, Death Certificates, Marital Status / Single Status Affidavits.
  2. Marriage & Divorce Deeds: Muslim Marriage Deeds (Kabinnama / Form 999), Special Marriage Act 1872 Marriage Certificates, Christian / Hindu Marriage Registration certificates, and Registered Talaknamas.
  3. Police & Criminal Records: Police Clearance Certificates (PCC) issued by the Special Branch (SB) of Police / Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP).
  4. Academic & Educational Credentials: Secondary (SSC), Higher Secondary (HSC), Madrasah, Technical Education Board certificates, and University Undergraduate / Postgraduate degrees certified by the University Grants Commission (UGC).
  5. Judicial & Notarial Acts: Court Decrees (Partition decrees, Succession Certificates, Guardianship orders), Affidavits affirmed before a Magistrate, and Notarial Acts.
  6. Commercial Instruments: Certificates of Incorporation issued by RJSC, Memorandum & Articles of Association, and Board Resolutions.

sections.h2: 5. Step-by-Step Procedure for Document Legalization & MOFA Apostille
sections.content:
Before an Apostille is affixed by MOFA, the document must undergo strict Prior Administrative Verification to prove that the underlying signature and seal are authentic:

  1. Step 1: Originating Authority Attestation: The document must be certified by its primary administrative custodian (e.g. Ministry of Education for university degrees, Ministry of Law for marriage deeds).
  2. Step 2: English Translation by Authorized Sworn Translator: If the original instrument is in Bengali, a certified English translation must be prepared by an enrolled advocate or authorized translation bureau and notarized.
  3. Step 3: Submission to MOFA Consular Wing: Submit the original document and verified translation to the Consular & Welfare Wing, Ministry of Foreign Affairs (পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়), 1st Building, Segunbagicha, Dhaka.
  4. Step 4: Scrutiny Against Specimen Registries: MOFA officers cross-examine the administrative signatures against official specimen signature databases.
  5. Step 5: Affixing the Apostille: MOFA attaches the official 10-point Apostille Certificate (sticker/embossed seal) conforming strictly to the model annexed to the Hague Convention.

A Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) is the most frequently requested document for foreign immigration (US Green Card, UK Skilled Worker, Canadian Express Entry, Australian PR):

  • Apply online via pcc.police.gov.bd and deposit the BDT 500 Treasury Chalan fee under Code 1-2201-0001-2681.
  • The Special Branch (SB) conducts physical address verification in your home Upazila/Thana.
  • The PCC is issued under the signature and seal of the authorized Superintendent of Police (SP) or Deputy Commissioner (DC) of Police.
  • Submit the original PCC directly to MOFA Segunbagicha for Apostille endorsement.
  • The resulting Apostille PCC is immediately valid for USCIS, NVC, UK Visas & Immigration (UKVI), and IRCC Canada without requiring foreign embassy stamps.

For spousal visa sponsorship and family reunification abroad:

A. Marriage Certificate (Kabinnama / Nikahnama)

  1. Obtain the original registered Bengali Kabinnama (বাংলা কাবিননামা) from the government-licensed Muslim Marriage Registrar (Kazi).
  2. Prepare an official Certified English Translation under the Kazi's seal.
  3. Submit to the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs (Secretariat, Dhaka) for verification of the Kazi's license.
  4. Submit to MOFA Dhaka for final Apostille certification.

B. Birth Registration Certificate

  1. Verify that your Birth Certificate is registered on the central digital database everify.bdris.gov.bd with a 17-digit online registration number.
  2. Ensure that both the Bengali and English versions are digitally generated from the Union Parishad or City Corporation portal.
  3. Submit directly to MOFA for digital Apostille stamping.

For academic admissions and professional licensing (WES, ECE, UK ENIC):

  • SSC / HSC / Madrasah Credentials: Must first be verified by the Controller of Examinations of the respective Education Board (Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, etc.), followed by the Ministry of Education.
  • Public & Private University Degrees: Must be certified by the Registrar of the issuing university, followed by the University Grants Commission of Bangladesh (UGC), Agargaon, Dhaka.
  • Once UGC / Education Ministry authentication is complete, MOFA affixes the Apostille certificate, verifying academic legitimacy worldwide.

sections.h2: 9. Non-Apostille Countries: The Traditional Legalization Route (Gulf & Middle East)
sections.content:
If you are relocating to or doing business in countries that are NOT signatories to the Hague Apostille Convention (such as the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, or China):

The Traditional Chain Remains Mandatory: The document must receive the standard MOFA authentication stamp, followed by physical consular legalization at the destination country's Embassy in Dhaka (e.g. Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia, UAE Embassy Gulshan, Embassy of the State of Qatar) upon paying respective consular fees. Attempting to present an Apostille in non-member Gulf states will result in administrative rejection.

sections.h2: 10. Digital e-Apostille QR Code Verification Protocol
sections.content:
To eliminate document forgery, MOFA Bangladesh operates an electronic register (e-Register) under Article 7 of the Convention:

  • Every Apostille Certificate issued in Dhaka features a unique alphanumeric serial number and a secure cryptographic QR Code.
  • Foreign immigration officers, university admissions deans, or foreign judges can scan the QR code using any smartphone or visit the official MOFA e-Apostille verification portal.
  • The screen instantly displays the scanned original document, date of issuance, and the name and designation of the certifying MOFA officer, providing tamper-proof legal integrity.

sections.h2: 11. Real-Life Case Study: Legalizing Documents for US Master's Degree & Immigration
sections.content:
Background: Engr. Tanvir Ahmed received an offer for a Master's program in Computer Engineering at Georgia Tech, USA, with subsequent permanent residency sponsorship. The university and US immigration authorities demanded authenticated copies of his BUET Bachelor's transcript, Birth Certificate, and Police Clearance Certificate.

Chamber Action Blueprint:

  1. Secured Controller verification from BUET and UGC attestation at Agargaon in 48 hours.
  2. Validated his 17-digit online birth certificate and secured police clearance through Special Branch (SB).
  3. Submitted all three documents to MOFA Segunbagicha under the Hague Apostille protocol.
  4. MOFA affixed the official Apostille certificates within 48 hours.
  5. Because the United States is a Hague Convention member, Georgia Tech and US immigration accepted the apostilled records immediately without requiring any visit to the US Embassy in Dhaka, saving over $450 USD in third-party agency fees.

faqs.question: Does an apostilled Bangladeshi document need to be stamped by the US or UK Embassy?
faqs.answer: No! Under Article 3 of the Hague Apostille Convention, member states (including the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and all EU nations) are legally prohibited from requiring diplomatic or consular legalization once an Apostille is issued by MOFA.

faqs.question: Can an NRB living abroad get documents apostilled in Dhaka without traveling to Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: Yes. An expatriate can authorize an enrolled advocate or trusted representative in Dhaka to submit original documents for administrative verification and MOFA Apostille certification.

faqs.question: What is the fee for an Apostille Certificate at MOFA Dhaka?
faqs.answer: MOFA charges a nominal statutory government fee per document. There are no expensive consular surcharges unlike foreign embassies.

faqs.question: Can a manual (handwritten) Birth Certificate be apostilled in Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: No. MOFA strictly requires the 17-digit digitally registered Birth Certificate verified online on everify.bdris.gov.bd. Manual handwritten slips must first be digitized.

faqs.question: Is an Apostille recognized in Dubai, Saudi Arabia, or Qatar?
faqs.answer: No. The UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and other Gulf nations are not parties to the Hague Apostille Convention. For these nations, traditional bilateral legalization through their embassies in Dhaka remains mandatory.

faqs.question: How long does a MOFA Apostille certificate remain valid?
faqs.answer: An Apostille certificate itself does not expire. However, the underlying document may have statutory validity limits (e.g. Police Clearance Certificates are typically valid for 6 months from issue date).

faqs.question: Can a registered Power of Attorney executed abroad be apostilled?
faqs.answer: Yes. Foreign powers of attorney executed before Bangladesh embassies abroad can receive MOFA verification and subsequent apostille endorsements for international commercial use.

faqs.question: How can foreign authorities verify the authenticity of a Bangladesh Apostille?
faqs.answer: Foreign authorities can instantly scan the embedded QR code on the Apostille certificate or enter the serial number into the official MOFA online verification registry.
